ZMB.note: No rule or authority on AI harms stated.
The utility pilot is a water-sector tool, not general administration.

facts.fact: UNDP Zambia and the Lusaka Water Supply and Sanitation Company launched a pilot using AI to locate non-revenue water, with the MOU still to be signed.

systems.platform: timbuktoo EDGE node, University of Zambia AI UniPod
systems.owner: Lusaka Water Supply and Sanitation Company

facts.fact: UNDP says a prototype NRW platform will run on the timbuktoo EDGE sovereign compute node hosted at the University of Zambia AI UniPod.
